full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts necessary for the disposal of this civil appeal are, in a nutshell, that the respondents No.1 and 2 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.50 of 1996 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Feni Sadar, Feni against the appellant and the respondents No.3-5 as defendants for permanent injunction in respect of the schedule land as appended to the plaint. The plaintiffs' case, in short, is that the predecessor of the plaintiffs Mukunda Lal Das took yearly lease of the suit land measuring 25 decimals in the year 1973-74 which was renewed from time to time and ultimately he took permanent lease of the suit land for 15 years with effect from 1st Baishak, 1388 BS to 30th Chaitra, 1403 BS in SO file No.78(XII) of 1980-1981 by registered deed dated 10-7-1981. Later on, Khatian No.172 was prepared in the name of Mukunda Lal Das and he was in possession of the suit land by preparing trace map. Although the suit land was recorded as nal, it was in fact the east bank of Gazi Ganu Dighi near to Gazi Ganu Ashram. The defendant No.1 purchased 11 decimals in plot No.1543 of Gazi Ganu Dighi from a co-sharer and 1decimal from plot No.1542 behind the back of the plaintiffs and applied for settlement of 30 decimals land including 25 decimals of plaintiff of plots No.617 and 619, but the said application was rejected on 23-12-1995 by the defendant No.2 and subsequently affirmed by the Deputy Commissioner on 3-9-1996. After rejection of settlement application, the defendant No.1 tried to encroach on the settled land of the plaintiffs plot No.617 which is East-North part of the East bank of the Dighi for which the plaintiffs' father prayed to the defendant No.3 to re-fix the area, who by opening file No.8(XI1)96 asked Magistrate Zahedul Islam to submit a report and subsequently he submitted a collusive and biased report on 25-5-1996 without any inquiry and actual physical measurement and without any notice to the plaintiffs. On the basis of the said report prepared and submitted by the learned Magistrate the defendant No.1 forcibly has been threatening to dispossess the plaintiffs from the northern part of some land of plot No.617. If the plaintiffs are dispossessed from their land which they got by settlement, they will suffer irreparable loss and injury, hence the suit.
